episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: A woman gets trapped in a crazy virtual world along with five other humans and are now subject to the whims of wacky AI and their own personal traumas.

episodes.title: Candy Carrier Chaos
episodes.summary: The Digital Circus crew goes on a candy-filled adventure to capture a bandit that's stolen the Candy Canyon Kingdom's maple syrup. However, things goes wrong when both the bandit and Pomni suddenly fall under the map, revealing to the bandit the truth about this world and his existence.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Mildenhall Manor
episodes.summary: The team is back together to go on a CREEPY adventure this time. The King will have a shotgun. Zubl is waiting for a psychotherapy session. And Remember, it will go straight to Hell. So many interesting things.

episodes.title: Fast Food Masquerade
episodes.summary: Pomni and friends spend an honest day's hard work at popular fast food chain; Spudsy's! Keep an eye out though, Gangle is the manager and has a brand new mask… it's like she's a whole NEW person!

episodes.title: Untitled
episodes.summary: We aren't actually sure what this episode is about.

episodes.title: Remember
episodes.summary: The Amazing Digital Circus comes to an end.
